Rishi / Monica —

We can run a 20-minute controlled window at ~250 r/s but need a few constraints:

- Novaly must provide a single endpoint and a stable prompt set (we'll bind the KV cache and batching keys to the prompt id).
- We'll run a 30s ramp-up, 10m steady-state at 250 r/s is heavier than the 20m ask; can we do 5m steady + 5m taper? (I recommend 5m > peak verification).
- If their prompts are long or include large structured-output tokens, we should lower qps — ask them to share average and 95th percentile token lengths.

Guardrails checklist (short):
- Structured-output schema sample (JSON schema) + 2 example prompts
- Max tokens expected per prompt (avg / p95)
- Required top-p / temperature baseline for evaluation
- Authorized traffic origin (IP ranges) for the load window

I'll attach a minimal runbook and the load_test_plan.pdf I referenced. Also share the prompt_inventory_v1 template back to them with these bullets.

-Ben
